title: 前缀和后缀搜索
summary: 给定单词数组，查询同时具有指定前缀和后缀的单词最大下标，不存在返回 -1。
insight: 单词长度较小，可在构造时枚举每个单词所有前缀和后缀组合，以 prefix#suffix 为键保存最新下标。
pitfalls: 前缀或后缀可以为空串
重复单词应返回最大下标
构造时按下标递增覆盖即可保留最大值

solutions.title: 预计算所有前后缀组合
solutions.idea: 用空间换取每次查询常数时间。
steps: map[prefix#suffix]=index 覆盖旧值；f 直接读取或返回 -1

code.java: class WordFilter { private final Map<String,Integer> indices=new HashMap<>();public WordFilter(String[] words){for(int index=0;index<words.length;index++){String word=words[index];for(int prefix=0;prefix<=word.length();prefix++)for(int suffix=0;suffix<=word.length();suffix++)indices.put(word.substring(0,prefix)+"#"+word.substring(suffix),index);}}public int f(String pref,String suff){return indices.getOrDefault(pref+"#"+suff,-1);} }
code.kotlin: class WordFilter(words:Array<String>){private val indices=hashMapOf<String,Int>();init{for((index,word) in words.withIndex())for(prefix in 0..word.length)for(suffix in 0..word.length)indices[word.substring(0,prefix)+"#"+word.substring(suffix)]=index};fun f(pref:String,suff:String):Int=indices[pref+"#"+suff]?:-1 }
code.cpp: class WordFilter { unordered_map<string,int> indices;public:WordFilter(vector<string>& words){for(int index=0;index<(int)words.size();++index){string& word=words[index];for(int prefix=0;prefix<=(int)word.size();++prefix)for(int suffix=0;suffix<=(int)word.size();++suffix)indices[word.substr(0,prefix)+"#"+word.substr(suffix)]=index;}}int f(string pref,string suff){auto it=indices.find(pref+"#"+suff);return it==indices.end()?-1:it->second;} };
